description: Land Acquisition - RChunnakam Town west, Valikamam D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of a specific land parcel (0.0689 Hectare in Chunnakam, Jaffna) for a public purpose (construction of a water tower). It contains detailed property descriptions, owner names, and procedures for claiming compensation, making it primarily concerned with land and property matters, which fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
